name: Mountaineer Stormpike's Task
summary: At his post in Loch Modan, Mountaineer Stormpike needs a runner for urgent business beyond the valley. Mountaineer Kadrell sends you to find him, since Stormpike cannot leave his watch.

sections.title: A Watchman in Need of a Runner
sections.body: The northern guard tower is Stormpike’s post, and his watch keeps him from leaving Loch Modan. The Mountaineers are stretched thin by troggs and roaming wildlife. So Kadrell directs capable travelers to guards who cannot abandon their duties. Stormpike needs a messenger for business far beyond the region’s borders.

sections.title: From Tower to Distant Roads
sections.body: You find Stormpike atop the northern guard tower, looking out over the valley. He belongs to the prominent Stormpike clan and has affairs beyond Thelsamar’s frontier defenses. Carrying his message and supplies takes you across regional borders on his behalf. Your road leads from the loch onto the highways of Khaz Modan.

faq.q: Where do I find Mountaineer Stormpike?
faq.answer: Mountaineer Stormpike watches from atop the northern guard tower in Loch Modan, overlooking the surrounding trails.
Mountaineer Kadrell patrols near Thelsamar in Loch Modan and directs you to Stormpike’s tower.

faq.q: Why does Stormpike need an adventurer?
faq.answer: Stormpike cannot leave his post at the tower. His personal business lies far beyond Loch Modan, so he needs a traveler to carry his message.

faq.q: What happens after reporting to Stormpike?
aliases: what comes after mountaineer stormpikes task
faq.answer: Reporting to Stormpike completes this first step and opens his follow-up delivery, 'Stormpike's Order', which takes you to another territory.

faq.q: Is this related to the Stormpike Guard in Alterac?
faq.answer: Mountaineer Stormpike shares the name and blood of the Stormpike clan, known for the Stormpike Guard and its mining expeditions. His work here is a modest local errand.

faq.q: Do Horde players have an equivalent quest here?
faq.answer: No. Loch Modan is dwarven territory aligned with the Alliance, and its Mountaineers attack Horde travelers on sight.

angles.text: As a dwarf, you may feel a natural duty to help a fellow dwarf of the famed Stormpike line and honor clan ties across Khaz Modan.
As an Alliance traveler, you help regional mountaineers carry dispatches that keep Ironforge's garrisons supplied and coordinated across the eastern territories.
